content: Standard pattern for Python CLI self-install as user service, no dependencies: generate text template, write to per-user location, invoke system tool with explicit argv (never shell=True). macOS: plist (Label/ProgramArguments with sys.executable + -m sif cli, RunAtLoad=true, KeepAlive=true, ThrottleInterval=10, StandardOutPath/StandardErrorPath to ~/Library/Logs/) in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/; modern launchctl verbs: bootstrap/bootout/kickstart gui/501 (old load/unload deprecated but still common). Linux: systemd user unit in ~/.config/systemd/user/ with [Service] Type=simple (foreground, no forking), ExecStart=<abs python> -m sif watch, Restart=always/on-failure, RestartSec, [Install] WantedBy=default.target; then systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now; loginctl enable-linger forrest needed to survive logout. Windows: out of scope. Real examples: taosmd service_install.py, dotagent, agenttap docs, svci.
